digest.component_or_area: review-bot persistent tickets clone and autodeploy
propositions: The EBS-backed persistent tickets clone on the review-bot diverges during redeployment because the entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, preserving divergent history across redeploys.

The ensure-tickets script must fetch with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets and converge using rebar._store.sync.reconverge for compatible stores while preserving local-only commits.

Pre-epoch local clones whose pre-fetch tip is an ancestor of the readable prior remote tip must adopt the newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit via narrow reset, only when preconditions prove no local-only commit exists.
Fetch failures without credentials must preserve the local tip, emit operator-readable warnings, and return success to prevent aborting an already-cast Gerrit vote.
The ensure-tickets script must be added to autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS so ensure-script changes trigger automatic redeployment without manual bootstrap.
Convergence failures and adoption refusals must remain best-effort, leaving exact local tips intact and requiring explicit operator intervention for all ahead, diverged, or ambiguous states.
